business_profile.coverage_note: Built from the Grassdoor brand context handover, Brand Book and Copy Playbook (Grassdoor Copy and Creative project). Fields marked 'unknown' were not in those sources; confirm with the stakeholder.

company_overview.name: Grassdoor
company_overview.tagline: California's most trusted Cannabis Delivery Service
company_overview.mission: Do the hard work so ordering cannabis is easy: fast, reliable, safe and discreet delivery of the top California brands.
company_overview.vision: Be the default place Californians order cannabis from: the widest selection, fast and reliable delivery, and an effortless reorder (internal north star: the 'Amazon of cannabis', never named in customer copy).

legal.address: 3363 Glendale Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA (ZIP to confirm)

company_overview.status: Reopening ('Grassdoor is back') with wallet credit and a 20% credit-back offer. Customers date back to at least 2021.

value_proposition.primary_value: Super Fast, reliable delivery of all the top California brands in one place, with credit you earn back on every order.
value_proposition.unique_mechanism: Personal service at delivery-app speed: real-time ETA and live tracking, live customer service and budtenders, personal picks from your order history, and wallet credit earned on what you spend.
key_differentiators: Speed: 'Super Fast' delivery with real-time ETA and live tracking (no specific delivery time until confirmed)
Convenience: effortless reorder ('Start your next order')
Deals: 20% credit back into the Grassdoor wallet
Selection: all the top California brands in one place
Reliability: on time, safe and discreet; curbside hand-off
Quality: the freshest flower, tested by our buyer

services: On-demand cannabis delivery in its California delivery zone, met at the curb
Grassdoor wallet credit and the 20% credit-back program
free_resources: 'See if we deliver to you' address check

current_offer.wording: Get 20% back in Grassdoor Credit on every order you complete before {end date}. Credits go straight into your Grassdoor wallet for future orders.
current_offer.terms: Credits expire 90 days from the date of issuance. Credits are earned, never framed as free or a gift.
unconfirmed: Live end date (June/July 31 in old drafts vs September 30 in designs)
Whether credit stacks with other discounts

positioning.market_position: A trusted service provider, not a lifestyle brand: polished, professional and modern, never 'weedy'.
positioning.competitor_comparison: Unlike lifestyle cannabis brands such as STIIIZY, Grassdoor wins on reliability, speed, selection and ease. Convenience is benchmarked against Amazon, tone against Uber (to the point) and DoorDash (friendly, information-rich).
positioning.niche_focus: Customers in the delivery zone, especially lapsed customers returning for the reopening

brand_voice_summary.tone: Warm, clear and professional: a real person (Alex) from a reliable company, in plain American English. Full detail in voice-dna.json.

key_metrics: Review ratings appear in designs (4.7 / 1,900+ Google reviews, 4.8 on Leafly) but are not yet verified: do not use until sourced

primary_topics: Super Fast delivery and live tracking
content_pillars.content_mission: Make every message feel like a personal note from a service the customer trusts, with one clear offer and a real product or deal feed.
content_pillars.content_style: Short sentences, two-beat body (reason, then offer), one hero, three trust icons, one CTA, full legal footer.

primary_cta.when_to_use: Returning and lapsed customers; reorder and wallet-credit emails

secondary_ctas: See if we deliver to you

platforms.primary_platform: Email (CleverTap journeys with 1 to 2 personalized modules)

team.voice_owner: Alex (signs welcome and relationship emails; the Grassdoor Team signs offer emails by default)
team.stakeholder_feedback: Zack E (credits are earned, not given away)
